grasp_0.description: this grasp point is located on the handle of the dustpan

plane_0.description: The plane is a horizontal plane defined by the base of the dustpan. Its centroid is positioned at the geometric center of the dustpan's bottom surface.

plane_1.description: The plane is a vertical plane denoting the front of the dustpan, corresponding to the open side of the dustpan and facing the direction of trach collection.
